world.title: Trump’s “dismantling” of NIH research continues apace - The BMJ
world.summary: The premier health research funding agency in the US has had a tumultuous time since Donald Trump’s presidential return, and things are only going from bad to worse, reports Brian Owens When Donald Trump returned to the US presidency in January 2025, many biomedical researchers were uneasy about the antiscience turn that parts of the Republican Party had taken in recent years.1 But they hoped that the strong bipartisan consensus in Congress in support of the National Institutes of Health (NIH) would help shield the agency from serious damage.
